admin.actionFailed: The operation failed. Try again, or check the backend logs.

campaigns.title: Campaigns
campaigns.heading: Campaigns
campaigns.none: No campaign opened or running. Check the calibration below, import the history if the window is short, then open the campaign: it starts the following Monday.

live.startsOn: Starts on {{date}}. The roster and the reference are already frozen; if something is wrong, delete the campaign and open it again.

open.heading: Open the campaign
open.description: Freezes the active roster and draws the ten guardians. Pick the difficulty, which decides the size of the guardians, the groups of wounded and the challenge targets, then the starting Monday. Refused while a campaign is opened or running.

confirmBody.CURRENT_WEEK: The campaign starts on the Monday of the week in progress: it is running immediately and the days already played are rebuilt from the imported matches. The difficulty is frozen at this instant and can never be changed.
confirmBody.NEXT_WEEK: The campaign starts on the following Monday. The difficulty is frozen at this instant and can never be changed: it decides the size of the ten guardians.

stop.heading: Stop the campaign
stop.description: Closes the running campaign now, frozen at the last day that is over. Its score is never recomputed.
stop.confirmBody: The campaign closes today, with yesterday's base as its final score. The remaining weeks are never played. This cannot be undone.

delete.heading: Delete the campaign
delete.confirmBodyOpened: Campaign {{number}} has not started: deleting it removes its frozen roster and its ten guardians, nothing else. You can open a new one right away.
delete.confirmBody: Campaign {{number}} will be erased with its weeks, its days and its roster. Matches, challenges and rankings are kept. This cannot be undone.

login.heading: Command post
login.keyHint: The key opens synchronisation, roster management and campaign controls.
login.title: Administration

groups.repairHint: These rewrite history that is already written. Run them when a figure is wrong, not as part of an ordinary week.
groups.routineHint: The ordinary gestures of a day. Each one replays a whole scheduled job and is safe to run twice: every step is idempotent.

redraw.heading: Redraw the challenges
redraw.description: Throws away the current week's five challenges, draws five new ones from the catalogue as it now stands, then rebuilds progress and ranking. Use it when the draw itself became wrong: a challenge disabled or removed from the catalogue after the week opened.
redraw.confirmBody: The progress recorded against the discarded challenges is deleted with them: an operator who had completed one loses that completion, its points and the wounded it promised. Only the week in progress is touched. Replay the campaign afterwards.

rollover.heading: Run the rollover
rollover.description: Replays Monday's whole rollover: finalizes every past week left open, settles the campaign's Sundays, draws the week's challenges. It does not synchronize: run a synchronization first if the last matches are still missing.

syncAll.heading: Synchronize the squad
syncAll.description: Imports the recent matches of every tracked operator, then rebuilds progress, ranking and campaign. Several minutes, depending on the Riot rate limit.
syncAll.accepted: Synchronization started. Follow its progress in the panel above.

syncPlayer.heading: Synchronize one operator
syncPlayer.description: Catches up a single operator without replaying the others. Useful after an isolated failure during a scheduled run.

dailyTick.heading: Run the daily tick
dailyTick.description: Replays the whole midnight tick: draws the day's challenge, recalculates progress and the ranking, starts a campaign whose Monday has come and replays the campaign. Does nothing when everything is already up to date.

players.archived: Archived operator: a campaign counts them in its roster. They can be restored.
players.error: The roster could not be loaded.
players.frozenRoster: Campaign {{run}} runs on a roster frozen at {{roster}} operators. Its members' status is frozen until it ends, and nobody can be made active before then.

gettingStarted.addPlayers: Add each operator with their full Riot ID, in the form name#tag.
gettingStarted.share: Share the app's address with the team. The guided tour opens on its own the first time somebody visits, so nobody has to explain how it works.
gettingStarted.synchronize: Run a first synchronization to pull in their match history. The ranking and the colony fill themselves in every week after that.
gettingStarted.title: Getting started

players.heading: Roster
players.idle: No match in fourteen days. An active operator who has stopped playing makes the guardian and the group of wounded bigger without contributing to either.

remove.heading: Remove from the roster
remove.archiveBody: This operator took part in a campaign: they will be archived, not deleted. They leave the public site and are no longer synchronized, but the campaigns naming them stay readable. You can restore them.
remove.deleteBody: This operator took part in no campaign: they will be deleted for good, with their matches and synchronization traces. This cannot be undone.

kept.players: The roster and the operators' statuses

reset.confirmBody: This cannot be undone. Every match, challenge, ranking and campaign will be cleared. The roster and the catalogues are kept.
reset.blockedBySync: A synchronization is in progress. Wait for it to finish: it would be writing matches into the base being emptied.
reset.done: Data reset. Start a synchronization to re-import the history.

match.title: The match
match.statement: Every match played in Valorant feeds the base
match.description: A match is worth points by mode and outcome. Those points do *three things at once*: they hit the week's guardian {guardian} in full, and they split into food {food} and components {components}. The values are set so that *an hour of play pays about the same* in every mode.
match.foodUse: Feed the base {base} every day, and settle Sunday's rescued {wounded}.
match.componentsUse: Reach the wounded {wounded}: vehicles and expedition gear.

multipliers.title: The multipliers
multipliers.statement: Farming pays less, consistency pays more
multipliers.description: Two coefficients change the *value of every match*, so its damage {damage}, its food {food} and its components {components} at once. The first drops with the number of matches in the day. The second rises with the number of days played in the week {streak}. Neither touches the challenges.
multipliers.decayLabel: Yield, by rank of the match in the day
multipliers.decayNote: The day's matches are ranked from the strongest to the weakest: the best five count in full, whatever the order they were played in.
multipliers.streakLabel: Days played in the week {streak}, every match of the day is worth
multipliers.streakNote: A day counts if the operator played at least one valued match in it. The streak is individual: a skipped day loses nothing, and the count restarts at zero every Monday.
multipliers.example: Competitive win, sixth match of the day, fourth day played this week: *500 × 50 % × 1.06 = 265* damage {damage}, split into 80 food {food} and 185 components {components}.

week.title: The week
week.statement: One guardian per week, and every match of the squad hits it
week.description: Every Monday, a new planet: a guardian {guardian} with its hit points, and a group of wounded {wounded} it keeps on the ground. Every match of every active operator deals it damage as soon as it comes in. It can fall on Tuesday as well as on Sunday; the week keeps filling the reserves.

sync.title: Matches come in
sync.text: The guardian takes the hit, the reserves rise, and the base grows: *28 damage make one inhabitant* {base}.

midnight.title: The base eats
midnight.text: Each inhabitant eats *0.008 food* {food}. The daily challenge resolves, a new one is drawn. The streak {streak} moves on if the operator played.

sunday.title: The settlement
sunday.text: In this order: the last daily challenge, the guardian's attack if it is still standing, then the ship's return {rocket} with the rescued.

monday.title: New planet
monday.text: New guardian, new group, reserves kept: *a bad week is never paid for the next one*.

week.guardianNote: *Guardian hit points*: reference × week weight × 0.78 × active operators. Only the operators active on the opening Monday count; an inactive one is still tracked, but brings nothing and costs nothing.
week.famineNote: *Famine* only exists once the reserve is empty, that is after more than a week without a single match: each evening, 5 % of the unfed inhabitants die.

sunday.title: Sunday
sunday.statement: We bring back the smallest of three numbers, never more than the group
sunday.description: A wounded {wounded} only comes home with a *seat aboard*, a *bed at the base*, and a blockade *open by as much*. The challenges' wounded skip that rule: they leave first, spending nothing.

beds.value: *12 food* {food} per wounded, once the base's next seven meals are set aside. The ship never touches them.

breach.value: The share of hit points taken from the guardian {guardian}. It multiplies the extraction: 100 % if it fell.

rescued.value: challenges' wounded {challenge} + min( rest of the group, seats, beds ) × breach

example.extraction: Extraction: the smallest of the three, 20, × breach 75 %

sunday.exampleNote: Only the 15 extracted cost anything: 210 components and 180 food. The rest of the reserves is kept.
sunday.lossLabel: If the guardian survives: inhabitants lost, by breach reached
sunday.lossNote: The guardian attacks the base {base}: base × (1 − breach)² × 35 %. Missing by a little costs almost nothing, doing nothing costs a lot.

campaign.title: The campaign
campaign.statement: Ten weeks, ten planets, and a guardian whose size is known in advance
campaign.description: A campaign lasts ten weeks. Each week, a planet: a guardian {guardian} with a set number of hit points, and a group of wounded {wounded} of a set size. Both numbers are computed at the opening from the squad's reference, see section 06. The final score is the *base's population* {base}.

how.6: Big group, weak guardian: a supply race.
how.7: Small group, tough guardian: a siege.
how.10: The biggest group behind the biggest guardian.

campaign.exampleNote: Example for a squad of {{operators}} active operators at a reference of {{reference}}, that is {{weekly}} damage in an ordinary week: a Minor guardian falls in three days, an Elite takes more than a week. Groups grow by 4 % a week, the campaign gets harder and pays better as it goes.

open.title: Opening
open.text: From the backoffice. The roster is frozen and the ten guardians are sized, once and for all.

start.title: The following Monday
start.text: Week 1 begins. Every Sunday evening settles its week, every Monday opens the next.

close.title: Tenth Sunday
close.text: The campaign closes. The base's population {base} is its score; the rocket {rocket} shows one state per guardian defeated.

between.title: Between two campaigns
between.text: No guardian, no base, no reserves: only the weekly ranking {points} keeps running. Every campaign starts from zero.

calibration.title: The difficulty
calibration.description: The difficulty is picked by the administrator at launch and frozen for the ten weeks. It carries the *reference*, the number everything else is a multiple of: guardians, groups of wounded and challenge rewards, *per active operator*. The game plays the same at 2 as at 20. Nothing is derived from match history.

examples.PRO: Twice the guardian, and the harder written targets

facts.chosen: *Picked at opening* by the administrator, never measured. Amateur or Pro, and it is frozen for the whole campaign.
facts.perOperator: The reference counts *per active operator*. A squad of two faces a guardian half the size of a squad of four's.
facts.grid: It also decides *which catalogue grid* is played: every challenge carries two written targets, one for Amateur and one for Pro.
facts.once: The *week's weight* applies on top: the first planet is worth 0.60 reference, the tenth 1.35.

challenges.title: Challenges and ranking
challenges.statement: A challenge brings wounded home no matter what, and each wounded is worth one point
challenges.description: One *daily challenge* {challenge}, shared by the squad, drawn every morning from 28 and resolved the same evening. *Five weekly challenges*, one per difficulty, drawn on Monday from 100. Their wounded {wounded} are earned no matter what, but no challenge touches the guardian.
challenges.worthNote: Wounded per operator who validates, for a reference of {{reference}}. A perfect week, seven daily challenges and the five weekly ones, is worth 120 wounded per operator.

survivorsFormula.title: Wounded brought home
survivorsFormula.text: Per operator who validates, paid on Sunday {wounded}. The same relative weight for amateurs and for pros.

pointsFormula.title: Ranking points
pointsFormula.text: The weekly ranking {points} adds up guardian damage {damage}, multipliers included, and the wounded of validated challenges. Against 5,300 damage, challenges break ties, they do not make the ranking.

challenges.titlesNote: Honorary. One title per operator, none on a tie. The champion only exists during a campaign.

constants.title: The constants
constants.statement: The game values, at a glance

scrollTop: Back to the top of the page

lastSync.label: Synchronization
lastSync.tooltip: Every 30 minutes, the squad's finished matches are imported and the campaign is recalculated: resources, damage to the guardian and challenge progress.

intro.title: Your matches save lives
intro.claim: Every match is read automatically and feeds a *rescue mission* the whole squad shares.

base.title: The base is the score
base.claim: Your matches deal damage to the guardian and collect resources that upgrade the rocket and grow your base. *Your score climbs with it.*

spec1.label: base shared by the whole squad

spec2.label: rocket stages, one per guardian defeated

spec3.label: of inhabitants lost per night of famine

week.title: One planet, one guardian, seven days
week.claim: Every match by any operator hits the guardian. *Breaking through its lines* brings more wounded home on Sunday.

spec1.label: guardians to bring down, one a week

spec2.label: of the wounded extracted if it falls

spec3.label: killing blow, credited to whoever lands it

resources.title: Food and components
resources.claim: Components make the rocket bigger and food lets the base take in more inhabitants. *Every match grants resources*, with a bigger gain depending on the mode played.

challenges.title: One a day, five a week
challenges.claim: They bring back wounded *earned whatever happens*, spending no resource, and feed the individual ranking.

ranking.title: The week's contribution
ranking.claim: A summary of each player's contribution over the week. *Titles are awarded* to honour the effort.

session.name: Daily session
session.description: Play 3 matches, any mode, during the day.
